name: TameLocalChar.isClopen_primitive
summary: Closed: the primitive matrices are the column blocks of the compact group GL_n(O). Open: around a primitive matrix the standard datum is non-zero and locally constant, and its non-vanishing forces primitivity.

steps.claim: Closed: a matrix is primitive exactly when it is the block of columns indexed by a of some k ∈ GL_n(O) (`IsValuationPair.exists_firstCols_iff`), so the set is the image of the compact group GL_n(O) (`isCompact_intGL`) under a continuous map, hence compact and closed. Open: for a primitive y with left inverse s, the standard datum stdColDatum(χ, s) is locally constant (it is Schwartz–Bruhat, `stdColDatum_mem_schwartzBruhat`), non-zero at y, and every matrix where it is non-zero is primitive (`isPrimitiveMatrix_of_stdColDatum_ne_zero`): so the preimage of ℂ∖{0} is an open neighbourhood of y inside the set.
steps.lean:
IsClopen {y : Matrix n a F | IsPrimitiveMatrix O y} := ⟨by simpa [Set.image, eq_comm,
  valPair.exists_firstCols_iff] using ((isCompact_intGL isCompact_O).image_auto (firstCols (.trans
  (.sumComm ..) e))).isClosed, isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.2 fun _ ⟨_, _, h, _⟩ ↦
  ⟨_ ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ, isPrimitiveMatrix_of_stdColDatum_ne_zero h,
  (stdColDatum_mem_schwartzBruhat χ h).1 _, by simp [stdColDatum, invOnUnits, *]⟩⟩
